messages:
zoe: weird idea — tiny Couch→Crag pledge for next week. Do at least 2 outdoor runs or 1 boulder session by next Tuesday. Loser buys snacks. :mountain::banana: Who's in?

jon: i'm in. can we keep one option beginner-friendly? new to outdoor bouldering. :thumbsup: 

sam: count me. aiming for 3 short runs. also: post-crag tacos? :taco: 

maria: i can scout a short approach crag near the north side of the city — 15min walk from parking. will post routes (easy/med). :map: 

alex: small ask — can we organize a carpool? weeknights are tight for me. maybe 6pm meetup at office if we do evening. :car: 

zoe: @jon totally — i'll pin a beginner route and a couple beta vids. if it's raining we'll swap to a gym circuit instead. :umbrella: (no one wants sludge)

fitbot: Reminder: hydrate, stretch for 10min pre-activity, and allow 48h between intense sessions. Logging to #wellness if you opt in. :droplet: (auto-message)

jon: quick, totally unscientific poll — morning run (M) or evening climb (E)? reply with M or E.

sam: M :sunrise: 

maria: E — golden hour climbing sounds so good. :sunset: 

alex: E 

zoe: M (tiebreaker goes to me). OK morning it is. Meetup plan: `6:30am @ office lobby`, leave by 6:45 for the north crag. Bring layers and a headlamp if you want to warm up in low light.

jon: perfect. who wants snack duty if i don't make the runs? :) (reaction: :raised_hands:)

sam: me for snacks if i actually don't bail. otherwise i'll do post-crag tacos shift. :sweat_smile: 

maria: will share parking + approach notes tomorrow. anyone bringing pads or crash gear?

zoe: i have one pad and some tape. tagging reminder: please check ankle warmups — rolled an ankle last month, no fun.

alex: i'll bring a spare pad and a thermos. excited. 

fitbot: Logged event: Couch→Crag pledge — participants: zoe, jon, sam, maria, alex. Add yourself by replying here.
